-- Default PixelMapper Lua Script -- update(canvas, time) is called once per frame
function update(canvas, time) -- clear screen with black canvas:clear(0, 0, 0, 0)
local w = canvas:width() local h = canvas:height()
-- Draw a moving circle sweep local cx = w * 0.5 + math.cos(time * 2.0) * (w * 0.3) local cy = h * 0.5 + math.sin(time * 3.0) * (h * 0.3) local radius = 15.0 + math.sin(time * 5.0) * 5.0
-- Draw filled circle with color shifting over time local r = math.floor((math.sin(time) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255) local g = math.floor((math.sin(time + 2.0) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255) local b = math.floor((math.sin(time + 4.0) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255)
canvas:draw_circle(math.floor(cx), math.floor(cy), math.floor(radius), r, g, b, 255, true)
-- Draw some noise lines / points for i = 0, 10 do local nx = math.floor(w * 0.5 + (canvas:noise(i * 10.0, time * 0.5, 0.0)) * (w * 0.4)) local ny = math.floor(h * 0.5 + (canvas:noise(0.0, i * 10.0, time * 0.5)) * (h * 0.4)) canvas:set_pixel(nx, ny, 255, 255, 255, 255) end end
Patch.FixtureSetupScript:
-- Custom: Hanging Volumetric Branches patch:clear_fixtures()
-- Editable Parameters (in millimeters) local fixtureLength = 1500 -- 150cm local pixelsPerFixture = 36 local channelsPerPixel = 4 local numCircles = 4 local branchesPerCircle = 6
local distBaseToMid = 3000 -- 300cm from branch base to middle fixture local distMidToTip = 2000 -- 200cm from middle fixture to tip fixture local heights = { 20, 420, 820, 1420 } -- heights of each floor circle local radii = { 680, 550, 450, 400 } -- radii of each floor circle local angles = { 30, 22, 15, 5 } -- outward angle of branch (degrees) local droops = { 15, 12, 8, 4 } -- droop angle of branch (degrees) local offsets = { 0, -25, -50, -75 } -- rotational start offset of circle (degrees)
local dmxUniverse = 0 local dmxAddress = 0
local generateHelpers = false -- Set to false to disable helper structures (circles/branches)
local function patch_fixture(f) f:set_dmx(dmxUniverse, dmxAddress) dmxAddress = dmxAddress + (pixelsPerFixture * channelsPerPixel) if dmxAddress >= 512 then dmxUniverse = dmxUniverse + 1 dmxAddress = dmxAddress - 512 end end
for c = 1, numCircles do local h = heights[c] local r = radii[c] local alpha = angles[c] * math.pi / 180 local droop = droops[c] * math.pi / 180 local alpha_tip = alpha + droop local offset = offsets[c] * math.pi / 180
for b = 1, branchesPerCircle do if b == 1 then dmxUniverse = (c - 1) * 4 dmxAddress = 0 elseif b == 4 then dmxUniverse = (c - 1) * 4 + 2 dmxAddress = 0 end local theta = (b - 1) * (2 * math.pi / branchesPerCircle) + offset local dx = math.cos(theta) local dz = math.sin(theta)
-- Plant base coordinate local plantX = r * dx local plantY = -h local plantZ = r * dz
-- Branch direction vector (angled outwards) local bx = math.sin(alpha) * dx local by = -math.cos(alpha) local bz = math.sin(alpha) * dz
-- Middle attachment point local midX = plantX + distBaseToMid * bx local midY = plantY + distBaseToMid * by local midZ = plantZ + distBaseToMid * bz
-- Tip direction vector (with droop angle added) local bx_tip = math.sin(alpha_tip) * dx local by_tip = -math.cos(alpha_tip) local bz_tip = math.sin(alpha_tip) * dz
-- Tip attachment point (starts from mid, extends distMidToTip along bx_tip vector) local tipX = midX + distMidToTip * bx_tip local tipY = midY + distMidToTip * by_tip local tipZ = midZ + distMidToTip * bz_tip
-- Create middle fixture hanging vertically downwards along positive Y local midName = "Floor_"..c.."_Branch_"..b.."_Mid" local fMid = patch:create_line(midName, midX, midY, midZ, midX, midY + fixtureLength, midZ, pixelsPerFixture, channelsPerPixel) patch_fixture(fMid)
-- Create tip fixture hanging vertically downwards along positive Y local tipName = "Floor_"..c.."_Branch_"..b.."_Tip" local fTip = patch:create_line(tipName, tipX, tipY, tipZ, tipX, tipY + fixtureLength, tipZ, pixelsPerFixture, channelsPerPixel) patch_fixture(fTip)
if generateHelpers then -- DRAW DUMMY BRANCH STRUCTURE (Base to Mid and Mid to Tip) local branchStructMidName = "Floor_"..c.."_Struct_Branch_"..b.."_BaseToMid" local fStructMid = patch:create_line(branchStructMidName, plantX, plantY, plantZ, midX, midY, midZ, 0, 1) fStructMid:set_dmx(98, b)
local branchStructTipName = "Floor_"..c.."_Struct_Branch_"..b.."_MidToTip" local fStructTip = patch:create_line(branchStructTipName, midX, midY, midZ, tipX, tipY, tipZ, 0, 1) fStructTip:set_dmx(98, b)
-- DRAW DUMMY BASE RING (Base to Next Base forming a hexagon) local nextB = (b % branchesPerCircle) + 1 local nextTheta = (nextB - 1) * (2 * math.pi / branchesPerCircle) + offset local nextX = r * math.cos(nextTheta) local nextY = -h local nextZ = r * math.sin(nextTheta)
local ringName = "Floor_"..c.."_Struct_Ring_"..b local fRing = patch:create_line(ringName, plantX, plantY, plantZ, nextX, nextY, nextZ, 0, 1) fRing:set_dmx(99, b) end end end
